div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: NORMAL: email_outbox queued → drain → Resend → sent

div.style: color: rgb(90, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
drain leaves the queue untouched · ticket/approval show 'Email is not configured yet.'
RECOVERY: set RESEND_API_KEY → queue drains

div.style: color: rgb(90, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
complete_email → queued again, up to 5 attempts → failed with last_error
RECOVERY: Admin → Email delivery shows it · admin 'Resend email' (force)

span.p: row stuck in sending → reclaimed after 10 min by claim_email_batch

toast 'Approved, but the email failed' · application_notifications failed
